items.title: From warning to listing: UK’s largest retail investment platform opens access to crypto ETNs
items.summary: The U.K.'s largest retail investment platform, Hargreaves Lansdown, has reversed course following the FCA's decision to lift its retail ban on crypto ETPs in October.

items.title: XRP Ledger has fewer active accounts than last year, but bigger trades and more value
items.summary: Daily order-book traders fell about 40% from a year ago while volume rose 79%, as the value held on XRPL climbed above $4 billion.

items.title: Southeast Asia’s crypto funding rebounds to $680 million as investors focus on mature firms
items.summary: Blockchain investment in Southeast Asia in 2026 has been led by crypto financial services, though funding remains heavily concentrated  in Singapore and a handful of companies.

items.title: Poland upholds crypto bill veto as Zondacrypto scandal widens
items.summary: Polish lawmakers failed to overturn a presidential veto of crypto legislation as the Zondacrypto investigation expands and its Estonian operator enters bankruptcy.

items.title: Bitcoin ETF inflows hit $3.8B in strongest three-week stretch of 2026
items.summary: US spot Bitcoin ETFs drew nearly $1 billion in the latest week as Friday inflows stayed positive despite Bitcoin briefly falling below $79,000.

items.title: Robinhood isn't backing down after AMC CEO demands halt to stock tokens
items.summary: AMC boss Adam Aron called Robinhood’s stock tokens “synthetic equity” and threatened legal action. Vlad Tenev says the brokerage stands behind the product.

items.title: U.S. Sheriff’s association shifts opposition stance to Clarity Act to 'neutral'
items.summary: The law enforcement association said it has pivoted its position regarding the Clarity Act to neutral, months after it warned against a law it said would shield crypto crime.

items.title: U.S. added stronger than expected 162,000 jobs in August as labor market bounced back
items.summary: This morning's report will be key as the Fed considers whether to raise interest rates at its September policy meeting.

items.title: We checked 6 years of bitcoin data. The NFP report isn't big price mover
items.summary: Your day-ahead look for Sept. 4, 2026

items.title: Zcash jumps 20% to landmark $1,000 level as short sellers lose $34 million
items.summary: ZEC briefly traded above $1,020 as a sharp rally forced traders betting against the token out of leveraged positions.

items.title: Bitcoin clears $81,000 as privacy coins lead a broad crypto rally
items.summary: BTC pushed through the level that capped it in late August, while zcash gained 16% and dash 19%.

items.title: IMF confirms El Salvador’s bitcoin growth was funded by private donations, not public money
items.summary: The IMF confirmed that all bitcoin added to official holdings since June 2025 was sourced from private donations, with no public funds used for accumulation.

items.title: South Korea targets February 2027 rollout for full tokenized securities market
items.summary: Financial regulators unveiled a phased roadmap moving traditional capital markets onto distributed ledgers, concluding with onchain stablecoin settlement.

items.title: Live updates: Bitcoin tumbles after blowout August jobs print
items.summary: Net assets in spot bitcoin ETFs crossed $103 billion for the first time, with BlackRock's IBIT accounting for well over half the money.

items.title: OpenAI puts $1 billion behind cyber defense after unveiling AI that can find zero-days
items.summary: The company is subsidizing access to its Daybreak security platform after saying Astra can independently find previously unknown software flaws and turn them into working attacks.

items.title: One full bitcoin now buys a little more than 18 ounces of gold, the most since January
items.summary: Bitcoin is pulling ahead of gold even as both hard assets rally together, driven by fears that governments will inflate away their debt rather than by bond yields.

items.title: Bitcoin back above $81,000 as hike odds fade, Zcash leads with 15% jump
items.summary: Every major token gained on Friday as traders cut bets on a September Federal Reserve rate increase to a coin flip, though most of the majors are barely changed on the week.

items.title: U.S. banking agency gives blockchain bank OpenReserve initial OK to operate
items.summary: The Office of the Comptroller of the Currency granted a provisional charter to the new full-service bank, adding it to the growing mix of crypto-native institutions.

items.title: AMC CEO blasts Robinhood for stock token, putting synthetic shares in spotlight
items.summary: Adam Aron said AMC has no connection to Robinhood’s tokenized shares, reviving questions around how stocks are brought onchain.

items.title: Surprise nonfarm payrolls print sends Bitcoin back below 80K
items.summary: The US economy added far more jobs than expected in August, pressuring Bitcoin lower as traders repriced the odds of a Federal Reserve rate cut this month.
